words.learningSentence: Le juge a décidé d'infliger une lourde peine au coupable.
words.nativeSentence: The judge decided to inflict a heavy sentence on the guilty party.

words.nativeWord: to feign, to fake, to put on, to pretend to have

words.nativeSentence: He faked an illness to avoid going to work this morning.

words.nativeSentence: This position requires at least five years of experience in the field.

words.learningSentence: Le musée a tenté de recréer l'atmosphère de la France médiévale.

words.nativeWord: to beat with a whip, to whip, to flagellate.

words.nativeSentence: He managed to disentangle the tangled threads.

words.nativeSentence: He was accused of stealing the money.

words.nativeSentence: He grabbed him by the arm to stop him from falling.
